_comment: Uniform-FR campaign, olefin/CHA stage. Frozen BEFORE any reference, screen, or production run. Two arms only (abf, fr_uniform) -- no sham, no oracle, per user directive: in real use the landscape is unknown. Model system: rigid all-silica CHA (type-0 8-ring environment) + TraPPE-UA ethene/propene in the repo's LTA modelling convention; NOT a reproduction of the flexible H-SAPO-34 force field of Cnudde et al. (JACS 2020), whose system/CV/temperature logic this stage borrows. Rigid frameworks overestimate window barriers; the FROZEN classifier below, not the literature numbers, assigns each cell its regime.
_provenance: Do not edit after the first production run starts. Framework artifact cache/cha/framework.npz (window/cages located numerically; sphere-union confinement clips 0.0% of the two cages, admits 0.6% side-cage volume -- declared).

cells.note: preregistered fallback toward an establishment regime if propene 450 K is discovery-limited

sampler._note: fr_start = warmup end (the LTA sweep lesson); identical force-evaluation budget in every arm and cell

reference_rule.acceptance: split-half dF within 0.3 kT over the scoring range; adjacent-window overlap present; U(xi) and U_nonbond(xi) conditionals recorded for the entropy decomposition

screen.protocol: ABF-only, one run per cell, 8 seed labels batched, the production sampler above
screen.T_cover: first save with both cage fractions >= 0.05 AND all scoring bins visited (csum > 0 on every bin in [xi_A-1, xi_B+1])
screen.T_marg: first save s with TV(p_hat_s, uniform) < 0.10 sustained for all saves in [s, s+0.1T]

classifier.establishment_limited: T_cover < 0.25 T and 0.25 T <= T_marg <= 0.8 T
classifier.discovery_limited: T_cover > 0.5 T or any scoring bin never visited
classifier.otherwise: intermediate/censored -- reported, not forced into a box

screen.selection: run the two-arm production on every establishment-limited cell; keep one abf_sufficient cell (if any) as the neutrality control; discovery-limited cells get NO FR run and no rescue claim

fr_rate_rule: per selected cell, safety-only ladder {0.02, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20}, largest rate with min ancestor ESS/N >= 0.30 and max lineage share <= 0.05 over FR-active saves, chosen without reading any error metric
endpoints: campaign conventions: primary Delta I_F (paired median, 10k bootstrap seed 20260829), final non-inferiority +5%, tau atlas convention (persist 0.2T), KL(p||uniform) mechanism series, genealogy floors 0.30/0.05 (median-across-seeds), plus the three-panel aligned mechanism figure KL -> e_F' -> e_F with the FR start marked
gpu_policy: GPU 3 always; GPU 2 only while its other tenants are user 'yesom' or none -- a watchdog kills OUR GPU-2 jobs (by pid, never device-wide) if any other user appears
prohibited: tuning any FR knob on an error metric
adding arms/targets/cells after data are seen
claiming FR rescue on a discovery-limited cell
editing this file after the first production run starts
_amendments: A1 2026-08-30 (before any FR run on this system): the screen's absolute TV<0.10 threshold is beta-naive -- ethene 450 K plateaus at TV~0.35 driven by O(1 kJ/mol) estimator residuals (final ABF e_F 0.39 kJ/mol = 0.1 kT, barrier reproduced exactly), i.e. the marginal is as established as the bias allows. Resolution: cells the frozen classifier labels 'intermediate' are LICENSED for the two-arm run, with their ABF-only screen facts recorded as the per-cell prediction before unblinding; 'discovery_limited' cells remain excluded exactly as frozen; no FR knob changes.
